2608.02509.title: Optimizing Minimax Regret in Uncertain MDPs with Small Sets of Policies
2608.02509.paper_summary: Sequential decision-making in real-world applications often involves uncertainty about the environment's model. Uncertain Markov decision processes (UMDPs) represent the possible environments as a set of MDPs with shared states and actions but potentially different transition probabilities and rewards. Optimizing a single policy across all possible MDPs may sacrifice performance, while preparing an individually optimized policy for every MDP may violate operational, regulatory, or interpretability constraints on the number of policies that can be prepared and deployed. We consider settings in which model uncertainty is resolved shortly before execution, allowing the most suitable policy to be selected from a limited set prepared in advance. We introduce $k$-adaptable policy synthesis, which optimizes such a set of $k$ policies under a minimax-regret objective. We prove that the problem is NP-hard and develop KAPS, an exact nested branch-and-bound algorithm with problem-specific bounds and heuristics. KAPS jointly optimizes which MDPs share a policy and the policies themselves. Experiments across various UMDP benchmarks show that the largest reduction in regret consistently occurs when increasing from one to two policies. In the single-policy setting, KAPS is competitive with existing methods in solution quality and proves optimality substantially more often.
2608.02509.paper_summary_zh: 順序決策在現實世界應用中通常涉及對環境模型的不確定性。不確定馬可夫決策過程（UMDPs）將可能的環境表示為一組具有共享狀態和行動但可能具有不同轉移概率和獎勵的MDPs。對所有可能的MDPs優化單一策略可能會犧牲性能，而為每個MDP準備一個單獨優化的策略可能會違反在可以準備和部署的策略數量上的操作、法規或可解釋性限制。我們考慮在執行前不久解決模型不確定性的情況，這樣可以從事先準備的有限集合中選擇最合適的策略。我們引入了$k$-可適應策略合成，該方法在最小化後悔目標下優化這樣一組$k$個策略。我們證明了該問題是NP困難的，並開發了KAPS，一種具有問題特定界限和啟發式的精確嵌套分支界限算法。KAPS共同優化哪些MDPs共享一個策略以及策略本身。在各種UMDP基準測試中的實驗顯示，當從一個策略增加到兩個策略時，後悔的最大減少始終發生。在單一策略設置中，KAPS在解決方案質量上與現有方法具有競爭力，並且更頻繁地證明了最優性。
